Formula 1 heads into Sunday at Interlagos with Lando Norris on pole after a rain-soaked qualifying session dramatically reshaped the grid.
The McLaren driver beat George Russell by 0.204s in treacherous conditions, but Russell’s five-place engine penalty promotes newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli to the front row.

Liam Lawson starts third for Racing Bulls ahead of Nico Hulkenberg, Isack Hadjar and Oliver Bearman. Russell drops to seventh, while Charles Leclerc falls down the order with a 10-place engine penalty.

Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen face an even bigger recovery after power unit penalties put both at the back of the grid. With more rain possible on Sunday, another unpredictable Interlagos race could be in store.
Here is everything you need to know ahead of Sunday’s Brazilian GP.
How can I watch the F1 Brazilian GP?

F1 coverage can also be streamed via Sky Go or NOW, with highlights available free-to-air on Channel 4.

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton insists Ferrari tensions with Charles Leclerc are over: "We've squashed it"
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton has revealed that he and Charles Leclerc cleared the air in Sao Paulo following their clash at the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix, saying the tensions have been "squashed".
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿坚称，他与夏尔·勒克莱尔在法拉利的紧张关系已经结束：“我们已经化解了”
法拉利的两位车手彼此“进行了一次对话”，并准备放下他们在墨西哥大奖赛上的分歧
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
刘易斯·汉密尔顿透露，在F1墨西哥大奖赛上的冲突之后，他与夏尔·勒克莱尔已在圣保罗澄清了气氛，紧张关系已经“化解”。
此外，这位七届世界冠军坚持认为，这并不需要弗雷德·瓦塞尔的介入——因为车手们自己解决了分歧。
“我的意思是，弗雷德并没有在我和查尔斯的意义上澄清气氛，”他在圣保罗排位赛后接受天空体育采访时说。“我们坐下来谈了谈，把问题解决了，然后继续前进。我认为我们彼此仍然非常尊重。”
“我很高兴我们聊了聊。现在我们像平常一样继续前进。所以有时候在这些情况下，只需要进行一次对话，而且双方都没有提出任何要求。”
紧张情绪是在墨西哥比赛后产生的，汉密尔顿觉得他因为队友而失去了获胜的机会。勒克莱尔在开场圈攻击了这位英国人，两人都离开了赛道——结果，胜利归于马克斯·维斯塔潘。
瓦塞尔在墨西哥没有机会与两位车手一起会面，谈话被推迟到他们抵达圣保罗之后——勒克莱尔因孩子出生在欧洲停留了更长时间。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
在此之前，周四的新闻发布会上，汉密尔顿加倍强调了他从墨西哥站以来的言论，确认他认为勒克莱尔比任何其他车手都更用力地与他竞争。既然两人之间的对话已经进行，汉密尔顿坚称两人可以继续向前。
“只是双方都提出了自己的观点以及我们可以做得更好、相互支持的地方。所以我希望接下来能有更好的比赛，”他说。
勒克莱尔也确认，冲突已经解决，车手之间没有问题。
当被问及他与汉密尔顿的关系是否已经恢复良好时，他说：“是的，当然。我真的相信，当我们沟通时，事情立刻就会好很多。当然会有紧张，当然我们都想跑在对方前面，有时我们也会做错事。
“有时候在看待事情的方式上存在分歧也没关系。但同时，讨论这些问题会大有帮助。
“从我的角度来看，我当然非常直接，我认为沟通是件好事。我认为在这样的时刻之后，这总是必要的。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
“我认为这件事被放得太大了，而且也已经持续太久了。与此同时，那对我来说是非常特别的一周，所以我之前没法真正进行那些讨论。
“进行那些讨论很重要，但现在我认为那一章已经翻篇了，我觉得向前看会很重要。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton insists Ferrari tensions with Charles Leclerc are over: "We've squashed it"
Ferrari's drivers "had a conversation" with each other - and ready to move on from their disagreement over the Mexico GP
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Lewis Hamilton has revealed he and Charles Leclerc have cleared the air in Sao Paulo following their clash at the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix and the tensions have been “squashed”.
Moreover, the seven-time world champion insists it didn't require Fred Vasseur's involvement – as the drivers resolved their differences between themselves.

"I mean, Fred hasn't cleared the air in the sense of me and Charles," he said, speaking to Sky Sports after qualifying in Sao Paulo. "We sat and spoke and we squashed it and we're moving on. I think we still have a huge amount of respect for each other.
"And I'm glad we had a chat. Now we move on along just fine as normal. So sometimes in those scenarios it just takes having a conversation and there's been no demands from either side."

The tension arose following the race in Mexico, in which Hamilton felt he lost the chance to win because of his team-mate. Leclerc attacked the Briton on the opening lap, both left the track – and as a result, the victory went to Max Verstappen.

Vasseur didn't have a chance to meet with both drivers together in Mexico, and talks were postponed until they arrived in Sao Paulo – with Leclerc staying longer in Europe due to the birth of his child.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

Before that, during Thursday's press conference, Hamilton doubled down on his comments from Mexico, confirming he thinks Leclerc races him harder than any other driver. Now that the conversation between the two has taken place, Hamilton insists the pair can move on.
"It's just been both giving our points and areas that we can do better and support each other. So I'm hoping to have better races moving forward," he said.
Leclerc also confirmed that the conflict is resolved and the drivers have no issues with each other.

"Yes, of course," he said, when asked whether his relationship with Hamilton was good again. "I really believe that when we speak things are much better straight away. Of course there is tension, of course we want to finish ahead of each other and sometimes we are not going to do things right.
"And it's okay sometimes to disagree on the way you see things. But at the same time discussing about those then helps a whole lot.
"From my perspective, I was very straightforward of course and I think it was good to speak. I think this is always needed after a moment like this.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

"I think it took proportions that are way too big, but it has been around also for way too long. At the same time, it was a very special week for me so I couldn't really have those discussions before.
"And it was important to have those discussions, but now I consider that a closed chapter and I think it will be important to look ahead."

汉密尔顿确认他与法拉利队友勒克莱尔在墨西哥大奖站冲突后已经和解
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
法拉利车迷们。最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的赛事反应。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在巴西大奖赛之前，对他和法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔之间进行的澄清对话进行了透露。
在上周末的墨西哥大奖赛的首个回合中，法拉利队友发生了冲突。勒克莱尔试图超越从杆位起跑的七届冠军汉密尔顿。在这次超车过程中，两位车手都偏离了赛道，勒克莱尔重新加入赛道时处于领先位置。
因此，汉密尔顿跌至第三位，落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘，勒克莱尔因此事件被处以五秒罚时。
赛后，汉密尔顿对勒克莱尔与他激烈竞争的方式感到愤怒，并呼吁在车队内部进行严肃的谈话。
英国人在巴西大奖赛雨中排位赛之后被问及讨论的情况。
"弗雷德[瓦瑟尔]还没有在我和查尔斯之间澄清事情。我们坐下来交谈，我们解决了问题，现在我们继续前进，一切正常。所以有时候在这些情况下，只需要进行一次谈话，而且双方都没有提出要求。
"我认为我们仍然非常尊重对方。我很高兴我们进行了交谈。现在我们继续正常地前进。所以有时候在这些情况下，只需要进行一次谈话，而且双方都没有提出要求。
"我们只是互相提出我们的观点和我们可以做得更好的领域，互相支持。所以我希望未来的比赛能更好。"
汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔都因巴西大奖赛而受到发车处罚。由于汉密尔顿的赛车更换了新的动力单元，他将从最后一排发车，而勒克莱尔由于新的内燃机受到10位发车处罚，将从第14位发车。
巴西大奖赛将于11月8日周日下午2点（英国时间下午5点）举行。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton opens up on clear-the-air talks with Charles Leclerc after Mexican GP clash
Lewis Hamilton has confirmed he and Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc have cleared the air following their clash at the Mexican GP
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Lewis Hamilton has opened up on the clear-the-air chat he had with his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix.

The Ferrari team-mates clashed on the opening lap of the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend. Leclerc attempted to overtake the seven-time champion, who had started from pole position. Both drivers ran wide during the move, with Leclerc rejoining the track in the lead.
Hamilton dropped to third behind Max Verstappen as a result, and Leclerc was handed a five-second penalty for the incident.
After the race, Hamilton was furious with how hard Leclerc had raced him and called for serious talks within the team.
The Briton was asked about the discussions after a rain-soaked qualifying session for the Brazilian Grand Prix.

"Fred [Vasseur] hasn’t cleared the air in the sense of me and Charles. We sat and spoke and we squashed it and we’re moving on," Hamilton said when asked by Sky Sports F1 whether team principal Vasseur had managed to patch things up between the two drivers.

"I think we still have a huge amount of respect for each other. And I'm glad we had a chat. Now we move on along just fine as normal. So sometimes in those scenarios, it just takes having a conversation and there's been no demands from either side.
"It's just been both giving our points and areas that we can do better and support each other. So I'm hoping to have better races moving forward."

Both Hamilton and Leclerc are taking grid penalties for the Brazilian Grand Prix. Hamilton will start at the back of the grid due to his Ferrari being fitted with a new power unit, while Leclerc will start from 14th due to a 10-place grid penalty for a new internal combustion engine.
The Brazilian Grand Prix will take place on Sunday 8 November at 2pm local time (5pm UK time).

detailZh: 维斯塔潘在巴西大奖赛排位赛推迟期间观看英超联赛：“这12个小时我再也拿不回来了”
维斯塔潘表示，周六在巴西对他来说是浪费的一天，因为他已经知道自己将从队尾发车。这位荷兰车手预测，从车阵中往前追赶会比往年困难得多。
维斯塔潘在圣保罗的一级方程式排位赛Q1结束后便收工，因为他已因引擎相关的罚退确定将在巴西大奖赛从队尾发车。
在国际汽联的“指示性发车格”上，维斯塔潘列第21位，排在刘易斯·汉密尔顿之后、塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
这位四届世界冠军在第一节排位赛中再次证明了自己在湿地条件下的竞争力。他的第一个飞驰圈比当时榜首的成绩快了1.4秒，也比随后不久冲过起终点线的汉密尔顿快了0.4秒。这位红牛车手最终以第三名结束了排位赛的首节较量——排在兰多·诺里斯和乔治·拉塞尔之后——随后便从赛车中爬了出来。
当被问及在巴西的雨中是否至少享受了一些乐趣时，维斯塔潘在媒体采访区回答道：“并没有，因为我没有在争夺任何东西。我的心思已经放在明天了，所以只是跑一个圈，不去冒任何风险。我跑的每一圈，我们都排在前列，但对我来说这并不意外。”
和其他车手一样，由于红旗中断，维斯塔潘不得不等了将近一个半小时才能驶上赛道。当被问及在暴雨期间他是如何度过这段时间时，维斯塔潘在Viaplay的镜头前笑道：“看足球。英超联赛。”
当被问及具体看了哪场比赛时，维斯塔潘继续说道：“看了很多不同的比赛，但在我上车前的最后一场是诺丁汉森林对曼城。比分是3比1，我上车前还真看到了一粒精彩的进球！”
当有人指出，车迷可能很难相信维斯塔潘在必须应对极其困难条件下的排位赛前不久还在看足球时，这位荷兰人平静地回应：“但我反正要从最后一位起步，所以无所谓。我今天浪费了12个小时的生命，再也拿不回来了。”
为什么维斯塔潘认为2026年的 逆转驾驶会更难
周六对维斯塔潘来说无关紧要，但周日自然会有所不同。维斯塔潘已经在英特拉格斯上演了三场令人难忘的逆转比赛，包括过去两个赛季。
2024年，维斯塔潘从第17位发车夺冠，实际上扼杀了诺里斯剩余的争冠希望；而去年，这位荷兰人从维修区起步一路登上领奖台。
因此，从后排起步并不一定意味着他没有机会，但维斯塔潘认为，驾驶2026年的赛车一路超车会困难得多。
“过去（有可能反击），但现在我们没有DRS了。而且这里的超车模式非常受限，因为直道很长，”维斯塔潘说。
“每个人都在消耗电池，所以你在直道上的速度差会小很多。这真的会有点像墨西哥，所以超车会比平时困难得多。”
尽管如此，下雨当然可能助一臂之力。圣保罗明天再次预报有雨，这也是法拉利决定在这里让两位车手接受发车位处罚的考虑因素之一。
detailEn: Max Verstappen watched Premier League football during Brazilian GP qualifying delay: "12 hours I'll never get back"

Max Verstappen says Saturday in Brazil was a wasted day for him, as he already knew he would be starting from the back of the grid. The Dutchman predicts that fighting through the field will be considerably more difficult than in previous years

Max Verstappen called it a day after Q1 during Formula 1 qualifying in Sao Paulo, as he already knew he would be starting from the back of the grid for the Brazilian Grand Prix due to an engine-related grid penalty.
In the FIA's 'indicative grid', Verstappen is listed in 21st place, behind Lewis Hamilton and just ahead of Sergio Perez.

The four-time world champion once again demonstrated in Q1 just how competitive he can be in wet conditions. His first flying lap was 1.4 seconds faster than the time at the top of the leaderboard at that point, and four tenths quicker than Hamilton, who crossed the start-finish line shortly afterwards. The Red Bull driver eventually finished the opening segment of qualifying in third place – behind Lando Norris and George Russell – before climbing out of the car.

Asked whether he had at least enjoyed himself to some extent in the Brazilian rain, Verstappen replied in the media pen: "Not really, because I'm not fighting for anything. My mind is already set on tomorrow, so it was just about doing a lap, not risking anything. Every lap that I did, we were up there, but for me that's not a surprise."

Like his fellow drivers, Verstappen had to wait almost an hour and a half because of the red-flag delay before he could even get out on track. Asked how he had spent that time during the heavy rainfall, Verstappen laughed in front of Viaplay's camera: "Watching football. Premier League."

Asked which match he had been watching exactly, Verstappen continued: "A lot of different games, but Nottingham Forest-Manchester City was the last one before I got into the car. It was 3-1, I actually saw a great goal just before I got back in!"

When it was pointed out that fans might find it hard to believe Verstappen had been watching football shortly before having to tackle qualifying in extremely difficult conditions, the Dutchman responded calmly: "But I'm starting last anyway, so it doesn’t matter. I’ve lost 12 hours of my life today that I’ll never get back."
Why Verstappen believes a comeback drive will be harder in 2026

While there was nothing at stake for Verstappen on Saturday, Sunday will naturally be a different matter. Verstappen has already produced three memorable comeback races at Interlagos, including in the past two seasons.
In 2024, Verstappen won from 17th on the grid, effectively nipping Norris's remaining title ambitions in the bud, while last year the Dutchman drove from the pitlane to the podium.
Starting from the back row therefore does not necessarily mean he has no chance, but Verstappen believes fighting his way through the field with the 2026 cars will be considerably more difficult.
"It was [possible to fight back] in the past, but now we don't have DRS anymore. And the overtake mode is very limiting around here, because of the long straight," Verstappen said.
"Everyone is draining the battery, so your speed difference on the straight is going to be a lot less. It will be a bit like Mexico really, so it will be quite a lot harder to pass than normal."

Nevertheless, rain could of course lend a helping hand. Rain is once again forecast for tomorrow in Sao Paulo, which was also one of the considerations behind Ferrari's decision to take grid penalties for both drivers here.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has explained the decision that sparked George Russell's furious team radio outburst during Brazilian Grand Prix qualifying. Russell finished second in the rain-soaked session at Interlagos behind McLaren's Lando Norris.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫回应拉塞尔在巴西大奖赛排位赛中的愤怒无线电
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫解释了在巴西大奖赛排位赛中引发乔治·拉塞尔愤怒无线电爆发的决定
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的比赛分析。
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫已就乔治·拉塞尔在巴西大奖赛排位赛期间的愤怒车队无线电消息作出回应。
这位英国车手在雨中的英特拉格斯赛道练习赛中获得第二名，落后于迈凯伦车队的兰多·诺里斯。在中途的第三节排位赛最后一圈冲刺中，由于雨势加大且亚历克斯·阿尔本的威廉姆斯赛车在他前方，布拉克利车队要求他减速。
当时，当明显雨势过大无法继续该节比赛时，拉塞尔在车队无线电中愤怒不已。
“伙计，你让我减速！搞什么鬼？！”他在车队无线电中说道。沃尔夫回应告诉拉塞尔他排名第二，但这并未让这位车手满意。“第二。我不想当第二。我想当第一。”
由于他的梅赛德斯赛车更换了新的内燃机，拉塞尔在巴西大奖赛中被罚退后五位发车，因此将从第七位起步。
排位赛后，沃尔夫在接受天空体育F1采访时解释说，当时无法预知哪种决定才是最佳选择。
沃尔夫解释道：“如果我们能有一颗水晶球，知道是否应该收油，那会很有帮助。”
“这是一个艰难的决定，五五开。他当时正接近阿尔本。在那个阶段，他比诺里斯快了18毫秒。我不认为这足以拿到杆位，但他整节练习与排位都开得很完美，配得上杆位。
“他配得上，但你无法做出那个判断。对错各占一半。今天拉塞尔独处一档。”
拉塞尔将沮丧情绪搁置一旁，表示他对自己的梅赛德斯赛车感到有信心。
“这取决于天气。我在场上感觉很好，”这位英国车手在排位赛后的电视采访中说道。
“这是我一段时间以来第一次对赛车感到有信心。我在湿地上比在干地上更有信心。我不太明白为什么会这样。我感觉更像我自己，每一圈都在争夺杆位。不幸的是，在关键时刻，我们没能执行好。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff responds to George Russell's angry radio messages in Brazilian GP qualifying
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has explained the decision that sparked George Russell's furious team radio outburst during Brazilian Grand Prix qualifying
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has addressed George Russell's furious team radio messages during qualifying for the Brazilian Grand Prix.

The British driver finished second in the rain-soaked session at Interlagos behind McLaren's Lando Norris. The Brackley outfit told him to back off midway through his last push lap in Q3 as more rain approached and Alex Albon's Williams was ahead of him on track.
At the time, Russell fumed over the team radio when it became clear the rain was too heavy to continue with the session.

"Mate, you told me to back off! What the hell?!" he said on the team radio. Wolff responded to tell Russell he was P2, but that did not satisfy the driver. "P2. I don't want to be P2. I want to be P1."
Russell has received a five-place grid penalty for the Brazilian Grand Prix after his Mercedes was fitted with a fresh internal combustion engine, so will start the race from seventh.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1 after qualifying, Wolff explained there was no way of knowing what the best decision was at the time.
"If we were to have a crystal ball to know whether you should back off or not, that would be helpful," Wolff explained.

"It was a difficult one, a 50:50 call. He was running into Albon. He was 18 milliseconds up on Norris at that stage. I don't think it would have been enough for pole, but he drove perfectly all session and merited to be on pole.
"He deserved it, but you can't make that call. It's 50% right or wrong. George was in a league of his own today."
Putting his frustrations to one side, Russell said he felt confident in his Mercedes machinery.
"It depends on the weather. I felt good out there," the Briton said in his televised post-qualifying interview.

"It's the first time in a while I've felt confident in the car. I felt more confident in the wet than I do the dry. I don't really understand why that was. I felt more like myself, was in the fight for pole every single lap. Unfortunately, when it mattered, we didn't execute."

items.originalTitle: F1 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix starting grid with seven penalties
detailZh: 巴西大奖赛的发车网格线看起来非常不寻常，因为包括乔治·拉塞尔、马克斯·维斯塔潘以及两位法拉利车手在内的七位车手在伊纳戈斯赛道受到了多项处罚。
拉塞尔和勒克莱尔分别从排位赛的第二和第四位下降到第七和第十四位，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘并没有参加全部的练习赛，因为他们知道他们将要受到发车网格线的处罚。
塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯也有处罚，但由于凯迪拉克车队是后起车队，这对这位起跑位置为第二十二位的驾驶员影响不大。
尽管他和维斯塔潘因为引擎部件更换而只受到了30个位置的网格线处罚，而汉密尔顿则受到了75个位置的处罚，但汉密尔顿仍然可以起跑在前面，因为他设定了所有必须从网格线后自动起跑的人中最快的时间。
典型的领先赛车缺席加上一场湿滑的练习，让一些不熟悉的面孔出现在前十名，甚至接近最前方。
利亚姆·劳森和尼科·胡肯伯格将共享第二排发车位，奥利·比尔曼为哈斯车队起跑第六，而费尔南多·阿隆索和亚历克斯·阿隆分别为2026年陷入困境的阿斯顿·马丁和威廉姆斯车队起跑第八和第九。
在比赛当天，奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特奥托和小红牛车队的阿维德·林德布拉德确认了进一步的处罚。
博尔特奥托在Q1的预赛中发生碰撞出局，并为比赛更换了新的能量存储和控制电子设备，但由于汉密尔顿、维斯塔潘和佩雷斯获得了更大的积分下降，因此10个位置的处罚实际上并不算处罚——所以博尔特奥托仍然排在第19位。
林德布拉德的车在第二阶段比赛中发生故障，小红牛为其更换了新的内燃机和涡轮，因此受到了10个位置的处罚，从第12位降至第18位，仅领先博托莱托、汉密尔顿、维斯塔潘和佩雷斯。

detailEn: The Brazilian Grand Prix starting grid has an unusual look with multiple penalties for seven drivers including George Russell, Max Verstappen and both Ferrari drivers applied at Interlagos.

Russell and Leclerc drop down from their second and fourth positions in qualifying respectively, to seventh and 14th, while Lewis Hamilton and Verstappen were not full session participants as they knew they had back-of-the-grid penalties to come.
Sergio Perez also has a penalty but Cadillac being a backmarker, it makes little difference for the driver due to start 22nd.

Though he and Verstappen 'only' had 30-place grid penalties for engine component changes compared to Hamilton having 75, Hamilton starts ahead because he set the fastest time of all those who must automatically start at the back of the grid.
What the absence of typical leading cars has done, coupled with a wet session, is allowed for some unfamiliar faces in the top 10 and very close to the front.

Liam Lawson and Nico Hulkenberg will share the second row of the grid, Ollie Bearman starts sixth for Haas, while Fernando Alonso and Alex Albon are eighth and ninth for 2026 strugglers Aston Martin and Williams respectively.
On the day of the race, further penalties were confirmed for Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad.

Bortoleto crashed out of qualifying in Q1 and has taken a new energy store and control electronics for the race, but the 10-place penalty that incurs is in reality no penalty at all owing to the greater drops being taken by Hamilton, Verstappen and Perez - so Bortoleto remains 19th on the grid.

Lindblad's car broke down on track in Q2 and Racing Bulls has fitted a new internal combustion engine and turbo to his car, incurring a 10-place penalty that drops him from 12th to 18th on the grid - ahead of only Bortoleto, Hamilton, Verstappen and Perez.

皮亚斯特里认为，迈凯伦在巴西大奖赛排位赛中换上半雨胎的时机太晚。
这位澳大利亚车手在因雨推迟的英特拉格斯排位赛中位列第12，不过在法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿因动力单元更换被罚后，他将从第10位起步。
皮亚斯特里使用全雨胎通过了第一节排位赛，但赛道条件已改善到足以让各车队在第二节排位赛中换上半雨胎。
“我刚完成一圈，但我觉得我们换上干胎可能稍晚了一些，需要再多一两圈才能真正让轮胎达到温度，”皮亚斯特里在排位赛后向媒体解释道。
“我在全雨胎上使用的一些走线在半雨胎上肯定行不通，所以当然有一些东西需要复盘，但我认为再多一圈、或许做出稍好一些的决定，我们本可以跻身其中。”
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦
当被要求澄清他是否在指责红旗导致他损失了那一圈时，这位迈凯伦车手补充道：“我肯定本可以再多跑一圈，但这对每个人来说都是一样的。”
“每个人都会多跑一圈，所以我不确定。我认为肯定还有更多时间可以争取，但你只需要在正确的时间用上正确的轮胎。”
展望正赛，皮亚斯特里解释说，如果雨水再次降临，比赛将会很有挑战性。
他说：“我们先看看天气如何，再作打算。我认为雨战会非常具有挑战性，所以看看情况再说。”
皮亚斯特里的队友兰多·诺里斯锁定了巴西大奖赛的杆位。诺里斯和皮亚斯特里目前分别以221分和144分位列车手积分榜第六和第七。
detailEn: Oscar Piastri explains what led to Brazilian GP qualifying disappointment
Oscar Piastri believes McLaren's late switch to intermediate tyres cost him a place in Q3 during a rain-affected Brazilian Grand Prix qualifying session
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
Oscar Piastri believes McLaren left it too late to switch to intermediate tyres in qualifying for the Brazilian Grand Prix.

The Australian driver qualified 12th in a rain-delayed session at Interlagos, although he will start from 10th after penalties are applied to Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton for power unit changes.
Piastri made it through Q1 on full wet tyres, but conditions had improved enough for teams to switch to intermediates in Q2.

"I'd just finished a lap, but I think we probably went onto the inters a little bit too late and needed that extra lap or two to really get some temperature in them," Piastri explained to the media after the session.

"Some of the lines I was using on the wets definitely didn't work on the inters, so some things to review, of course, but I think with another lap and maybe slightly better decisions we could have been there."
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren
When asked to clarify if he was blaming the red flag for costing him the lap, the McLaren driver added: "I definitely would have got one more lap in, but it's the same for everybody.
"Everyone would have got another lap, so I'm not sure. I think there was definitely a lot more time out there, but you just need to be on the right tyre at the right time."
Looking ahead to the grand prix, Piastri explained the race will be challenging if the rain returns.
"We'll see what weather we get first and go from there. I think it's going to be very challenging in the rain, so let's see what we get," he said.

Piastri's team-mate Lando Norris secured pole position for the Brazilian Grand Prix. Norris and Piastri currently sit sixth and seventh in the drivers' standings with 221 and 144 points, respectively.

detailZh: F1巴西大奖赛：兰多·诺里斯在湿滑的排位赛中夺得杆位
兰多·诺里斯将在周日的F1巴西大奖赛中从杆位起步，这是在圣保罗一场激动人心的湿滑排位赛之后的结果
在F1巴西大奖赛的湿滑排位赛中，麦克拉伦的兰多·诺里斯在危险的英特拉戈斯赛道上击败乔治·拉塞尔，夺得了杆位
由于大雨和积水，这场充满挑战的排位赛因雨势过大而暂停超过一小时，诺里斯在最终Q3的冲刺赛中，以1分27.470秒的成绩在中间胎上领跑，仅比梅赛德斯的拉塞尔快了两十分。
拉塞尔因动力单元更换而受到五位的发车位置处罚，但他对梅赛德斯车队要求他在Q3的第二次飞驰圈放弃感到愤怒。
安东内利以比诺里斯慢六十分之一秒的成绩获得第三名，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第四名的成绩为法拉利车队参赛。除了拉塞尔的降级，勒克莱尔的10位引擎处罚使得第五名的青训车队车手利亚姆·劳森在周日的发车位置上升至第三位。
劳森在车队考虑提升预备车手尼古拉·索洛夫的情况下，压力巨大，但这位新西兰人表现出色，为车队提供了思考的空间。
尼科·胡肯伯格在第六位为奥迪车队闪耀，随后是红牛车队的伊萨克·哈德贾和哈斯车队的奥利弗·贝尔曼。费尔南多·阿隆索和亚历克斯·阿隆索在周六完成了前十名。
在Q2阶段，阿隆索是首位切换到中性胎的车手，他希望通过这种方式将他的阿斯顿·马丁车队从车群的底部提升出来。其他车手也很快效仿，拉塞尔在绿色墙面的复合胎上跑出了1分26.745秒的成绩，获得了第一的位置，领先于看起来很棒的劳森和哈吉亚。
新晋的世界冠军安东内利仅以第10名的成绩勉强晋级，他在淘汰法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿，而汉密尔顿由于动力单元处罚，原本就将在最后一排发车。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂也未能晋级，这位麦凯轮车手的表现令人失望，排名第12。哈斯车队的新人拉斐尔·卡马拉尽管在比赛中失控，但仍然成功晋级到Q2，但在练习结束时，他在12号弯直接撞上墙壁，导致晚些时候红旗出动。
在小红牛的第二辆赛车中，阿维德·林德布拉德由于动力单元问题被淘汰，排在第14位，随后是威廉姆斯车队的卡洛斯·塞恩斯。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘由于自己的引擎处罚，与汉密尔顿一起排在最后一排发车，但他并没有在Q2中被淘汰，被列为第16位。
在一场早前的降雨和更多降雨在即的情况下，Q1准时开始，但就在比赛开始前，天气状况恶化。
几名车手立即停车，请求推车后退并交换他们的中间轮胎为全湿地轮胎。那些出去的车手证实这是一个好主意，因为他们在报告了水滑现象后，赛车直接返回维修区，此时赛事控制员已经红旗暂停了比赛。
经过一个多小时二十分钟的延误后，比赛再次绿灯亮起，Q1还剩下15分钟进行，但条件仍然足够危险，需要使用全湿地轮胎。
尽管条件仍然不佳，但持续改善，这意味着需要给赛车加油，进行巡场并建立节奏，以便在比赛结束前达到最佳状态。诺里斯最终以1分30.939秒的成绩领先该阶段，比15分钟前的圈速快了10秒，领先于拉塞尔和维斯塔潘。
在赛道后部，哈斯车队的新秀卡马拉在经过第3个弯道后 不知怎么地幸存了一场打滑和与墙壁的接触，虽然他的前翼损坏了，但悬挂系统幸免于难，这让他从第13位前进，让巴西粉丝感到非常高兴。
阿尔皮讷车队在Q1中损失最大，弗朗科·科拉平托和皮埃尔·加斯利分别在第16位和第17位被淘汰，他们为完全缺乏抓地力而感到遗憾。兰斯·斯特罗尔也在第18位出局，随后是凯迪拉克车队的瓦尔特里·博塔斯和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
另一位巴西观众喜爱的车手，奥迪车队的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托，比卡马拉不幸，他在第12个弯道发生事故后损坏了车辆的左后部，他不得不进行一些拖拉机般的努力，将车从深深的泥潭中拖出来，然后返回维修区。
detailEn: F1 Brazilian GP: Lando Norris takes pole in soaking wet qualifying
Lando Norris will start Sunday's Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix from pole following a thrilling, wet qualifying session in Sao Paulo
McLaren's Lando Norris has claimed pole in a wet qualifying session at Formula 1's Brazilian Grand Prix, beating George Russell on a treacherous Interlagos circuit.

In a challenging session that was red-flagged by over an hour due to heavy rain and standing water, Norris topped the final Q3 shootout with a 1m27.470s lap on the intermediate tyres, pipping Mercedes' Russell by two tenths.
Russell was nursing a five-place grid penalty for a power unit change, but was still incensed by his Mercedes team asking him to abort his second flying lap in Q3.

Antonelli qualified third, six tenths behind Norris, with Charles Leclerc fourth in the Ferrari. As well as Russell's demotion, Leclerc's 10-place engine penalty elevated fifth-placed Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson to third on Sunday's grid.

Lawson is under pressure to retain his seat as Racing Bulls considers promoting reserve driver Nikola Tsolov instead, but the New Zealander delivered a standout performance to give the squad food for thought.
Nico Hulkenberg also shone in sixth for Audi, followed by Red Bull's Isack Hadjar and Haas driver Oliver Bearman. Fernando Alonso and Alex Albon completed the top 10 on Saturday.

In Q2 Alonso was the first driver to switch to intermediates as he aimed to lift his Aston Martin out of the belly of the pack. Other soon followed suit, and Russell secured P1 with a 1m26.745s lap on the green-walled compound, ahead of an impressive looking Lawson and Hadjar.
Newly-minted world champion Antonelli only just managed to advance in 10th, knocking out Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, who is already due to start at the rear anyway with a power unit penalty.

Oscar Piastri also failed to advance, the McLaren driver a disappointing 12th. Haas rookie Rafael Camara had done well to progress to Q2 despite going off, but he then crashed at the end of the session by going straight into the wall at turn 12, bringing out a late red flag.

In the second Racing Bulls car, Arvid Lindblad was dumped out in 14th due to a power unit issue, followed by Carlos Sainz in the Williams. Red Bull's Max Verstappen, who joins Hamilton at the back of the grid with an engine penalty of his own, did not go out in Q2 and was classified 16th.
Following an earlier downpour and more rain on the horizon, Q1 started on time but with conditions worsening right before the session went green.

Several drivers immediately parked their cars to be pushed back and exchange their intermediates for full wet tyres. Those who did go out confirmed that was a good idea, with cars heading straight back in after reporting aquaplaning as race control red-flagged the session.
After a delay of over an hour and 20 minutes, the session was green-lit again with 15 minutes of Q1 running on the clock and conditions still treacherous enough to warrant full wet tyres.

With conditions still poor but continuously improving, that meant it was a matter of fuelling up the car, circulating and building up a rhythm to peak at the end of the session. Norris ended up leading the segment with a 1m30.939s, 10 seconds quicker than lap times just 15 minutes prior, ahead of Russell and Verstappen.

At the rear of the field Haas debutant Camara somehow survived a spin and contact with the wall after Turn 3, which broke his front wing but spared his suspension, to advance in 13th to the delight of the Brazilian fans.

Alpine was the biggest loser of Q1 with both Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly eliminated in 16th and 17th, ruing a complete lack of grip. Lance Stroll was also out in 18th, followed by Cadillac duo Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Perez.

The other Brazilian crowd favourite, Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto, was less fortunate than Camara and damaged the left-rear of his car after an off at Turn 12, engaging in a bit of tractor pulling to wrangle his car out of a deep muddy puddle and return to the pits.

detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫解释梅赛德斯工厂内部邮件泄露到网上的经过
托托·沃尔夫解释他在安东内利2026年夺冠后发给全厂、随后泄露到网上的那封充满情绪的邮件
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
赢得F1世界冠军会激起许多情绪，通常还会开很多香槟。但对梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫来说，安东内利在墨西哥城历史性夺冠，让他突然产生冲动，要给员工写一篇极长的文章。
在巴西大奖赛第三节自由练习赛的转播中，天空体育F1主持人西蒙·拉岑比提到了一封最近流传到网上的、相当鼓舞人心的梅赛德斯内部邮件。
沃尔夫以一贯的面无表情风格，立刻调侃了这位主持人居然真的花时间把整封邮件读完了。
“你读了这么长的一封邮件？它挺长的，”沃尔夫开玩笑说。当拉岑比确认自己从头读到尾后，沃尔夫回击道：“我很惊讶，我上一次写[那么长的东西]还是在学校里压力山大的时候。”
玩笑归玩笑，沃尔夫解释了这封长篇信息背后的情感催化剂。作为正式签字同意让一个青少年坐进刘易斯·汉密尔顿传奇座驾的人，沃尔夫当时正被媒体和围场里涌来的祝贺信息淹没。他并不想要这些。
“那为什么是即兴的？因为那个周日晚上，我因为给了他机会而收到了太多赞誉，在意大利也是如此，”沃尔夫向天空体育团队解释道。“这让你非常自豪。但我觉得我需要把功劳归于所有可能不太受关注的人。”
一级方程式是终极的团队运动，把一名新秀从残酷的2025年低谷推向2026年世界冠军，需要整个工程师、策略师和导师团队的努力。沃尔夫想确保那些拧扳手、处理数据的男男女女知道，这座奖杯也属于他们。
“这封邮件，他甚至没有充分体现，因为还有更多人参与了决策过程，帮助他达到那个位置，”这位梅赛德斯老板继续说道。“这就是为什么我觉得至少需要向整个大团队表达我的感激之情。”
那么，一份私人的内部工厂备忘录是如何公开的？这要感谢梅赛德斯通讯主管兼高级领导层人物布拉德利·洛德。
当沃尔夫在深夜发出那封情绪激动的草稿邮件时，洛德显然觉得这条信息太精彩了，不该只锁在公司邮箱里。
布拉德利·洛德，梅赛德斯车队副领队
“然后布拉德利觉得这封邮件比平时更有巧思，”沃尔夫笑着说。“于是他就把它发到了领英上，结果就传开了。”
这可能是一次无心插柳的公关示范，但它让车迷难得地看到了沃尔夫在梅赛德斯车库内营造的育人文化，未经修饰、原汁原味。
detailEn: Toto Wolff explains the emotional Mercedes factory email leaked online
Toto Wolff explains the emotional, factory-wide email he sent after Kimi Antonelli's 2026 title win that leaked online
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Securing a Formula 1 world championship triggers a lot of emotions, and, usually, a lot of champagne. But for Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff, Kimi Antonelli's historic title win in Mexico City triggered a sudden urge to write an incredibly long essay to his staff.

During the Free Practice 3 broadcast at the Brazilian Grand Prix, Sky Sports F1 presenter Simon Lazenby brought up a rather inspiring internal Mercedes email that recently made its way onto the internet.
Wolff, in classic deadpan fashion, immediately roasted the broadcaster for actually taking the time to read the whole thing.

"Did you read such a long email? It was quite long," Wolff joked. When Lazenby confirmed he read it all the way through, Wolff fired back, "I was surprised the last time I wrote it [something that long] was under severe pressure in school."

Jokes aside, Wolff explained the emotional catalyst behind the massive message. As the guy who officially signed off on putting a teenager into Lewis Hamilton's legendary seat, Wolff was getting flooded with congratulatory messages from the media and the paddock. He didn't want it.

"So why was it spontaneous? Because I got so much praise on that Sunday night about giving him the opportunity and in Italy," Wolff explained to the Sky Sports crew. "And it's something that makes you very proud. But I felt I needed to give credit to all the people that maybe weren't so much in the spotlight."

Formula 1 is the ultimate team sport, and pushing a rookie through a brutal 2025 slump to a 2026 World Championship took an entire village of engineers, strategists, and mentors. Wolff wanted to make sure the men and women turning the wrenches and crunching the data knew this was their trophy, too.

"This email, he didn't even give it justice because there is many more that were part of the decision-making process and getting him to where he was," the Mercedes boss continued. "And that's why I felt like I need to at least express my gratitude to the big team."
So how did a private, internal factory memo end up public? You can thank Mercedes communications boss and senior leadership figure Bradley Lord for that.
When Wolff hit send on his emotional late-night draft, Lord apparently decided the message was far too good to keep locked inside the company inbox.
Bradley Lord, Mercedes Deputy Team Principal
